name: Earthquake
overview: Scripture reveals that earthquakes are powerful acts of God’s sovereign judgment and presence, demonstrating His wrath and authority over creation. The shaking of the earth, as described in Psalms and Isaiah, signifies divine intervention often accompanied by thunder, fire, and tempest. Prophets like Amos and Haggai highlight that God uses earthquakes to shake not only the physical world but also the spiritual and political realms, underscoring His control over all things.
